items.summary: Les régions du Québec ont rattrapé leur retard économique par rapport à l’Ontario, mais l’écart de richesse entre Toronto et Montréal se maintient, selon un rapport de l’Institut du Québec (IDQ) dévoilé mardi.

items.headline: What James Gunn and Peter Safran's departure means for future of DC Studios
items.summary: James Gunn and Peter Safran are to step down as co-chairmen and co-chief executives of DC Studios after four years, marking a major leadership shake-up at the company behind some of cinema's most recognisable superheroes, including Superman and Batman. items.headline: Canada amends, extends tariff relief program beyond U.S. steel imports
items.summary: The federal government is extending its relief program for firms importing tariffed U.S. goods and changing the mix of goods eligible for remissions.
